project_type: Python FastAPI app - Autonomous AI Company Operating System
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (auto mode), classes grouped by behavior, fixtures in tests/conftest.py
build_command: python3.12 -m pytest tests/ --co -q (collect-only to validate imports)
verification_instructions: Run python3.12 -m pytest tests/ -x -q and confirm all tests pass (900+ existing + new tests)
setup_instructions: python3.12 available at /usr/bin/python3.12. Package installed via python3.12 -m pip install. NEXUS importable via python3.12 -c 'import nexus'
environment_constraints: Python 3.12 at /usr/bin/python3.12. Default python3 is 3.9 (DO NOT USE). pip install requires python3.12 -m pip. No Docker daemon available. No database available (tests use mocks/in-memory).
contribution_requirements: Type hints required. Docstrings required on all public classes/methods. Ruff formatting (100 char line length). Python 3.12 union syntax (X | Y not Optional[X]). Every module independently testable. New SQLModel tables added to models/__init__.py.
key_patterns: Dataclass-based in-memory state for runtime components (registry, executor, phase_machine, watchdog). SQLModel for DB models in src/nexus/models/. Tests use pytest classes with descriptive names, fixtures from conftest.py. Enums for state values. Protocol classes for dependency injection. No external DB in tests - all in-memory.
directory_structure: src/nexus/ - main package. models/ - SQLModel DB tables. tools/ - registry, executor, mcp_client. orchestration/ - phase_machine, smart_retry, planner, router. runtime/ - watchdog, heartbeat, lifecycle, executor. governance/ - approvals, budget, circuit breaker, kill switch. evolution/ - failure_alchemy, observer. memory/ - layered memory system. tests/ - flat test files following test_<module>.py convention.
